query.sql: SELECT creative_id, creative_name, creative_type, angle, description, description_tsv <@> to_bm25query(to_tsvector('english', 'high-energy social lifestyle creative for gen-Z apparel'), 'app.creatives_search_bm25') AS bm25_score FROM app.creatives_search ORDER BY bm25_score LIMIT 10;
